declarations: Packet serves no structure_shift_ref, pvp_* or bar_* values for ARHS; the trigger level is read from the stamped export at alert time.
Bracket fields are not a basis for any decision here (R1).
atr_14d 0.14 on a 72.83 entry is unreliable, so bar-width tests are not gradable.

trigger.plain: Wait for price to pull back into the broken Creek zone and hold there before any entry.

decisions.wrong_if: Daily close back under structure_shift_ref by half an ATR: the Creek break has failed and price is back inside value.
decisions.reason: TREND: swing HH/HL and EMA 9>21 on W, D and H1. But sma_distance_pct 49.84 and ext_atr20 4.55 put price far from value, so R2: do not chase (C3, C15). Extension sets entry location, not an oppose. Entry is the test of the Creek, then a sign-of-strength bar.

decisions.wrong_if: Not a long call; a daily close back under structure_shift_ref would end any long case.
decisions.reason: Hairline break: D close 0.1% above the last swing high, day_vol 0.94 (under 1.0) is a potential upthrust until it holds (C5). H1 below EMA9, swing LH but EL. atr_14d 0.14 is implausible, so R3 and R6 cannot be graded. Unclear read, R10: ABSTAIN, not an oppose.
